text:
Leah Kim: Weird canary signal from the new ember-ensemble int4 run: sporadic funcall failures where two complete JSON toolcall objects are concatenated without delimiter (e.g. '}{') and the parser blows up. Only on streaming + retries enabled.
Marco DeLuca: Can you paste a raw capture?
Leah Kim: Got one. This is from a mirrored canary where client retried after a perceived timeout and the runtime re-streamed the tail.
Leah Kim: ```
{"tool":"fetch","args":{"url":"/doc/123"}}{"tool":"annotate","args":{"span":10}}
```
Samir Anand: So basically two JSON objects were emitted back-to-back with no newline/comma. Parser expecting a single object fails. How often?
Leah Kim: Failure rate ~0.42% over 6k requests. Reproduces when stream=true, retry_on_timeout=true, client_batch=1. Mirrored baseline (no retries) had 0% failures.
Marco DeLuca: Token trace? Could be that retry replays previous completion fragment without a separator.
Leah Kim: Token fragment: [TOK_901]="}" [TOK_902]="{" [TOK_903]="\"tool\"" — shows '}{' boundary.
Samir Anand: This smells like lack of idempotency markers plus streaming concatenation when a retry resumes mid-output. Two tracks: 1) gatekeeper sanitization that detects concatenated objects and inserts a newline or wraps into an array as a short-term recovery. 2) fix at runtime/retry layer to guarantee a separator when re-streaming (or use idempotent call ids).
Marco DeLuca: I dislike silent fixes that mutate payloads for customers. If we do sanitization, it must be opt-in and heavily instrumented. Also we need to distinguish legitimate multi-object outputs vs accidental concat.
Leah Kim: Proposal: require an optional top-level `__call_id` in funcall outputs from the model when serving structured outputs. Use it to detect duplicate/replayed fragments. Gatekeeper rule: if two objects are adjacent and the second object's `__call_id` matches the first, treat as duplicate and dedupe; if missing IDs, fall back to conservative sanitizer that fails fast and logs.
Samir Anand: Implementation note: models won't emit `__call_id` by default. For onboarding, we can inject a synthetic tag in the prompt or postprocess to add it. But better fix: runtime retry should not re-emit previous terminal chunk; instead it should request model to continue or return error to client.
Marco DeLuca: Short-term plan: 1) gatekeeper add `concat_guard` sanitizer with config `structured_output.concat_policy: ["fail","insert_newline","wrap_array"]` default `fail`. 2) runtime change to add a `retry_separator` token when re-streaming. 3) onboarding fuzz job that simulates client retry/resume at chunk boundaries.
Leah Kim: I sketched the gatekeeper config: `structured_output.concat_policy=fail` by default, and `telemetry.concat_events=true` will record event labels: duplicated_call_id|missing_separator|wrap_attempted.
Samir Anand: Add metric `concat_detect_rate` and `concat_dedupe_rate`. If dedupe_rate > 0 then alert SLO owners.
Marco DeLuca: I'll prototype runtime patch to ensure when a retry attaches we prepend a special separator token (e.g., "\n") and make it configurable. We'll also add a backoff to avoid duplicate replays.
Leah Kim: QA: I'll add a regression test that forces a client-side retry at various token offsets and ensures no concatenation produced. Also add a golden-set check: when sanitizer runs in "insert_newline" mode, record golden diffs.
Samir Anand: Action items: 
- Leah: open repro issue with traces + sample requests and add test cases (assigned)
- Marco: runtime retry_separator PR + tests (taking)
- Samir: gatekeeper concat_guard PR + telemetry metrics (taking)
- qa-bot: create fuzz job that simulates retries at chunk offsets 0..10, chunk sizes 1..5 (scheduled)
qa-bot: [automated] canary 2833333000 recorded: 6000 requests, concat_detect_rate=0.0042, concat_dedupe_rate=0.0, retry_enabled=true.
Leah Kim: Let's not promote ember-ensemble to prod until concat_detect_rate < 0.001 or we have robust dedupe in place.
Marco DeLuca: Agreed. I'll start a small canary-run with runtime patch on staging once PR is up.
Samir Anand: Also add onboarding checklist item: "retry-concat fuzz" for all streaming-capable models.
Leah Kim: Thanks all. Ping me for reviews. :pray:
